snippet.title: KUR: Endless Descent | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
KUR: Endless Descent is an idle RPG that runs in a small window on your desktop. Your party descends through the underworld of Kur, fights on its own and keeps growing while you work, study or play something else.

Start with a single hero, build a party of three, craft and fuse your gear at the camp, and push through seven Domains and ninety-six floors of Mesopotamian myth.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5332430

#KUR #IdleRPG #IdleGame #IndieGame #Steam
